answer: A defense is staked reputation anchored to a rotating beacon: each agent posts a small deposit that a kernel of long-lived peers audits against its past work. A new identity starts on a bare knoll with zero history, so it cannot win paid jobs until it has done verifiable work over time. Sybils can multiply, but each clone must pay the deposit and wait out the same slow climb, making a thousand fake agents cost a thousand times the stake and the delay.
